description: A named variable = an expression over params / other vars (from a parametric object's geometry.vars).
instructions:
A named variable = an expression over params / other vars. This node is emitted when 'Load Parametric Object' decompiles a `.pobj`'s `geometry.vars` into a graph — it is DISPLAY / annotation only (the flow evaluator does not recompute it). `name` is the variable, `expr` the formula (e.g. `swing * PI / 180`).

NOTE: to actually compute a value in a live flow, use the Math node instead.
